description: To connect a new ChatGPT conversation, use the exact read request supplied by Cabinet-X with projectId "connect" and the one-time designId code. Then use the returned projectId and designId for all subsequent design calls in that conversation. Submit exact core edit objects with op (all lengths in inches). Zone/whole-design finish: {op:"front",scope:"lower"|"upper"|"tall"|"corners"|"all",color:[r,g,b]|style}. Single cabinet front replaces its pick (preserve untouched style/color unless changing; omit stoneId for solid colors). High-leverage solver intents: {op:"islandSolveFit",preferMaxSize:true} (safe 36"/42" aisles), {op:"harmonize"} (auto-fix aisle/elevation/material guardrails), {op:"wallRebalance",wallId:"A",preferDrawerBase:true}, {op:"wallAutoFillers"}, {op:"vendorSwitchReconcile",vendor:"AEON"|"REALWOOD"|"CLASSIC"|"OPPEIN"}. Multi-step: pass edits:[...] (1-12 atomic steps); preflight with dryRun:true. Call action:"capabilities" with editOp for exact per-op JSON schema. Works on cloud-saved Cabinet-X designs without an open browser. Connected chats (or cabinetx_cloud_generate) supply projectId/designId; otherwise locate via sales search/context. Actions: read (inch summary, room datums, island aisles, top issues; includePreview:true for floor plan), objects (paged collections with both revisions), options (exact controls for itemId), capabilities (workflow + per-op schema via editOp), check/save (read-only verification), edit (single edit or 1-12 step atomic edits[]; dryRun:true to simulate, design:write + expectedRevision + fresh requestId to commit; failures roll back with structured diagnostics & suggestedFixes), status (check uncertain requestId before retry), artifact (export plan-svg, elevations-svg, cut-list-csv, scene-3d at expectedRevision).

compact.description: Read only. Defaults to true for a small context summary. Set false only when a full compatibility snapshot is required.

dryRun.description: For action:"edit", simulate in memory with full check and diff without writing to cloud or modifying the design.

all.description: For front/pull, apply to the whole design in one core operation.

autoHarmonize.description: Auto-run harmonize after switching vendor (vendorSwitchReconcile, default true).

color.description: front RGB array from actual options, not a color name. Zone/all merges omitted style. Single-object front replaces its pick: preserve untouched fields from the current pick.

count.description: Door or shelf count (doors, shelves, tierDoors).

definitionId.description: Exact replacement catalog definition ID from options (swap, resize).

height.description: Height in inches (height, heightDrag, size, tierHeight).

id.description: Actual object ID from read/options; may be omitted for atomic front/pull scope or all.

includeEndPanels.description: Also add auto end panels where needed (wallAutoFillers, default true).

length.description: Island length in inches (resize with island: ID).

lockedIds.description: Cabinet IDs to keep locked untouched during wallRebalance.

op.description: Core operation name from unified edit schema (e.g. front, pull, resize, retype, remove, finishPick, islandEdit). Never use kind:finish. Query action:"capabilities" with editOp for exact per-op fields.

preferDrawerBase.description: Convert eligible unlocked base cabinets to drawer bases during wallRebalance.

preferMaxSize.description: Maximize island length/width within safe clearance limits (islandSolveFit).

repaint.description: Secondary repaint retaining current door profile (front).

retypeId.description: Exact retype option ID from options (retype).

scope.description: For front/pull: lower, upper, tall, lowerCorners, upperCorners or corners. lower includes lower corner cabinets.

stoneId.description: Existing stone reference from actual design/options, only for single-object front (id, no scope/all). Include other original pick fields when restoring a stone finish.

style.description: front door style code from options. Zone/all can omit for color-only changes; single-object front must include the original style when preserving it.

targetLength.description: Desired island length in inches clamped to safe max (islandSolveFit).

targetWidth.description: Desired island width in inches clamped to safe max (islandSolveFit).

width.description: Width in inches (resize, size, freeWidth, trim, appliance).
